title: Primality in polynomial-time BPP
statement: Every binary string whose little-endian binary value is prime belongs to the class of languages decidable by a finite randomized Turing machine in polynomial time with acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on every input and halting on every choice sequence of the prescribed length.
